title: Engine fixes from the 2025 scoring: extract_json last valid object, text/image disagreement settled by adjudication, false missing_text flag (REQ-0083)
acceptance_criteria: AC4 one real re-run on changed ids, held-out gain

design.summary: extract_json last valid object with schema check; text/image disagreement and tentative-text replacement settled by adjudication (default under --pdf, --no-adjudicate opt-out); refcheck figure sharing no longer keys on the Source pages line

implementation.summary: 76.1 extract_json takes the last valid object with schema check; 76.2 text/image conflicts (any status, tentative text) go to adjudication, default under --pdf with --no-adjudicate, source adjudicated; 76.3 refcheck sharing key no longer the Source pages line (refcheck diff over 125 files: only Science id 21 changed)

unit_test.result: 1537 tests, only the 4 known baseline failures; solve prompts of 295 exam files identical old vs HEAD; re-ingest changes only group members (16 in the 2025 refined doc); refcheck changed only Science id 21 over 367 questions; mutations killed; tester D1-D5 fixed

security.result: no finding; replies stay untrusted and schema validated; answers used for scoring only

verification.command: unit suite; free replays; paid re-runs on the learn exam (2025) and held-out sets
verification.result: REQ-0083 AC1-AC4 verified with a stated null accuracy result: the six fixes are correct and safe (verifier), but the measured accuracy gain is within noise: 2025 learn exam 113 to 111 of 120 (English 59 fixed; 17, 39 run-to-run variation; 27 harmed by adjudication, now opt-in); keyed regression set unchanged (15 pass, 18 of 18 identical); 2026 slice 36 to 36 (comparable 39: 32 to 36 from earlier phases); the gain is removal of context-delivery defects (lost second JSON object, group table not shared, adjudication prompt without options, false missing_text flag); limits: noise about 5 percent flips, n of changed answers 1-4

quality.reason: learn and held-out sets scored against the official answers; prompt identity at HEAD; the null result is stated

crosscheck.waiver: the oracle is the official answers (scoring only): learn exam and two held-out sets scored by the coordinator; defects traced by the inspector against the PDF; identity of 295 prompts by the tester
